The Hessian's Shares From a Refreshed Block's Own Movement

Source: R/jfp_engine.R
jfp_refresh_hessian.Rd

Computes the terms of \(\partial_{kl}\log|\tilde I|\) that the movement of the block's rows contributes, for a block inside a subformula of a term whose block is recomputed at the coefficients.

Usage

jfp_refresh_hessian(st, bs, dE)

Arguments

st

A state, from jfp_state().

bs

A block's entry of the state, of kind "refresh".

dE

The derivative of the expected information, from jfp_dexpected().

Value

A list with H, a matrix over the joint vector, and BV, the rows to add to the low-rank factor at the term's positions.

Details

With \(\tilde I = \sum_t w_tI_t\tilde V_t^\top\tilde V_t\) over the block's equation, \(P = \tilde V\tilde I^{-1}\) and \(I_{c,t}\) the derivative of \(I_t\) in the predictor of equation \(c\), \(\mathrm{tr}(\tilde I^{-1}\partial_{kl}\tilde I)\) gains $$2\sum_t w_t\Big[\sum_c I_{c,t}\big(X_c[t,k]R_{tl} + X_c[t,l]R_{tk}\big) + I_t\,\mathrm{tr}\big(P_t^\top\,\partial_{kl}\tilde V_t\big) + I_t\,\partial_k\tilde V_t\,\tilde I^{-1}\partial_l\tilde V_t^\top\Big],$$ with \(R_{tl} = P_t\,\partial_l\tilde V_t^\top\); the rows move in the term's own coefficients only. \(\partial_{kl}\tilde V\) is read from modelterms7::term_block_deriv2() by the symmetry of the third derivative of the predictor. The product \(\mathrm{tr}(\tilde I^{-1}\partial_k\tilde I\,\tilde I^{-1} \partial_l\tilde I)\) gains the whitened derivative \(\sum_t w_tI_t(W_{k,t}^\top Z_t + Z_t^\top W_{k,t})\), \(W_k = \partial_k\tilde V\,U^{-1}\), in the rows of the low-rank factor.
